CREATE PROC [DW].[HIST_SP_DW_FACTDEPOSITSOUTSTANDINGBALANCE] @Businessdate [VARCHAR](10) AS
BEGIN

WITH CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance 
    WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date'
    AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'  and customeraccountid IN ( '0010d8d9813f82a4c7045673b77554c7' , '03db521d41bb9c82784d2a0bf503bcb9')
    --AND @Businessdate BETWEEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODSTARTDATE,112) AND ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODENDDATE,112),'20991231')
)
, CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
,
Cnt_DCA
AS(
--    SELECT BCB.CustomerAccountId, COUNT(1) CNT FROM CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCB
--    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.AccountID 
--    and DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
--    GROUP BY BCB.CustomerAccountId
select Accountid,
count(shareindicator) as CNT
 from dw.dimcustomeraccount where shareindicator = 'y'
 group by accountid
)
,
Balance AS (
SELECT 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCPB.PeriodStartDate,112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
--,CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BCPB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate
--    ELSE BCPB.BalanceAmount END  AS BalanceAmountFull
--,CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BCPB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate )/ ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  
--    ELSE BCPB.BalanceAmount / ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  
--    END AS BalanceAmountProrated
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm

,BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode
,BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId
,BCPB.BalanceAmount
,ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1) CNT
FROM 
CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCPB
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CAFP.ProductId = FPA.FinancialProductId AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDBK ON BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID
--LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCPB.PeriodStartDate = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
--LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory BAAS ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = BAAS.CustomerAccountId AND BAAS.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankId
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDHT ON BAAS.RecordTypeId = DDHT.AccountHolderTypeID AND BAAS.SourceSystemCode = DDHT.SourceSystemCode AND DDHT.BankSK = DDBK.BankSK
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DCA DCA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.AccountId 

--LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory BAAS ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = BAAS.CustomerAccountId 
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDHT ON BAAS.RecordTypeId = DDHT.AccountHolderTypeID
--LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAFP ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = convert(varchar,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId)
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON convert(varchar,BCAFP.FinancialProductId) = DDP.ProductId
--LEFT JOIN BNKM.FinancialProduct BFP ON convert(varchar,BCAFP.FinancialProductId) = BFP.FinancialProductId
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimProductType DDPT ON BFP.ProductTypeId = DDPT.ProductTypeId 
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
--and @Businessdate NOT IN (SELECT BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance)
)

--select * from  Balance order by 1


, GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
    BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,convert(DATE, MIN(BusinessDateSK)) AS min_date
    ,CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) max_date 
  FROM 
    balance
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
	GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
--select * from GetMinMaxDate

,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
	,SourceSystemCode
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,fulldate,112) AS fulldate2
    ,a.FullDate
    ,b.min_date 
    ,b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
--select * from FullDateBalance
--order by FullDate


,distinct_balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountId ,BusinessDateSK ,BalanceAmount ,SourceSystemCode ,WorkFlowId ,TaskRunId ,InsertDttm ,IsoCurrencyCode ,FinancialInstitutionId ,CNT
FROM Balance b
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
--select * from distinct_balance
--INSERT INTO DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance
--(
--     BusinessDateSK
--    ,BranchSK
--    ,BankSK
--    ,AccountSK
--    ,AccountID
--    ,BalanceAmountFull
--    ,BalanceAmountProrated
--    ,SourceSystemCode
--    ,WorkFlowId
--    ,TaskRunId
--    ,InsertDttm
--)
--SELECT
-- ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate) AS BusinessDateSK
--,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
--,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
--,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
--,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
--,BalanceAmountFull BalanceAmountFull1
--,BalanceAmountProrated BalanceAmountProrated1
--
--,COALESCE(BalanceAmountFull, LAG([BalanceAmountFull]) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode ORDER BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode)) AS [value]
--
--,MAX(BalanceAmountFull) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode,b.BusinessDateSK
--ORDER BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode) AS BalanceAmountFull
--,MAX(BalanceAmountProrated) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode
--ORDER BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode) AS BalanceAmountProrated
--,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
--,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
--,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
--,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm
--FROM FullDateBalance a
--LEFT JOIN DISTINCT_BALANCE b
--    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
--    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
--    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
--    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
--    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
--    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode
--
--    order by 1

, help1 as (
select 
 ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate) AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm                           

,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BalanceAmount
,CNT

,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BankSK,a.AccountId ORDER BY a.FullDate ) AS Row#
, case when [BalanceAmount] is null then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN DISTINCT_BALANCE b
    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode

)

, help2 as (
select *, Sum(ChangeIndicator) over (PARTITION BY BankSK, AccountId ORDER BY Row#) RowGroup from help1
)

, final_balance as (
select 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId

,case when BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode is not null then BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode else first_value(BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end IsoCurrencyCode
,case when BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId is not null then BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId else first_value(BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end FinancialInstitutionId
,case when [BalanceAmount] is not null then BalanceAmount else first_value(BalanceAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end BalanceAmount
,case when [CNT] is not null then CNT else first_value(CNT) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end CNT

,BCPB.SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm                           

from help2 BCPB) 


select 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
--,BalanceAmount
--,ConversionRate
--,ConversionRate
--,CurrencyConversionTimestamp
--,cnt
,CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate
    ELSE BalanceAmount END BalanceAmountFull
,CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate )/ CNT
    ELSE BalanceAmount / CNT  
    END BalanceAmountProrated
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm    
INTO DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_TEST_CURRENCY                       
from final_balance BCPB
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON  BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode  = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCPB.BusinessDateSK = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
order by accountid, BusinessDateSK


END
GO
